author: Home RenoVision DIY
description:
I’m using Muddskip drywall additive to repair badly over-sanded drywall corners and skim coat these damaged walls without waiting hours between coats. Muddskip lets me apply drywall compound wet-on-wet once it’s dry to the touch, so I can rebuild the corners, fill sanding grooves and get a smooth drywall finish faster while showing you the proper way to sand drywall without ruining your work.
